**Date:** 14 March 2031, when the project's final route was confirmed.

**Person:** Marisol Treadgold, Chief Engineer of the Dunmarrow Waterways Authority.

**Figure:** The 11-kilometre tunnel is budgeted at 2.4 billion Verrian marks, with boring planned to take six years.

**Source document:** The Dunmarrow Canal Tunnel Feasibility and Route Report (Report DWA-31/07), presented to the Harlow Basin Regional Council.
